subject.title: fix(feishu): disable ambient proxy inheritance for WebSocket by default

question: Should Feishu WebSocket egress switch from ambient-proxy-by-default to direct-by-default with `OPENCLAW_FEISHU_WS_USE_PROXY=1` opt-in, or should proxy inheritance remain the default until the broader Feishu proxy policy is settled?
rationale: The code change is small, but it changes upgrade behavior and an operator egress-control boundary for existing proxy-dependent installations.

options.title: Finish Direct-Default Contract
options.body: Require opt-in docs, test cleanup, current-head real transport proof, and then accept direct-by-default for Feishu WebSocket.

options.title: Preserve Proxy-Dependent Upgrades
options.body: Keep ambient proxy inheritance as the default and add an explicit Feishu direct/bypass mode for affected users.

options.title: Pause For Broader Proxy Policy
options.body: Hold this PR until Feishu HTTP, WebSocket, and mixed-proxy behavior are decided together with the adjacent proxy-policy work.

recommendation.title: Finish Direct-Default Contract
recommendation.body: Require opt-in docs, test cleanup, current-head real transport proof, and then accept direct-by-default for Feishu WebSocket.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is a proxy/security-boundary policy choice, and this owner is tied to the shared ambient proxy helper used by the affected path.
